title: Entity
description: Abstract base schema for IFS entities. Concrete schemas define their own entityType and ID prefix.

id.description: Globally unique entity identifier in EntityType/ID form.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator, fixed by the concrete entity schema.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this entity record was created.
